AC-OPS-01i.evidence: owner/CI to run in a loopback-only network namespace: the offline wheel install, version, selftest and dashboard run with only loopback (pending owner run on a machine that allows user namespaces (no CI exists)). Everything except the namespace itself is asserted by the test on every run.

G9-screen-reader.evidence: Manual screen-reader pass over the dashboard screens (Phase G / H G9 gate); the axe and keyboard checks are automated, the screen-reader check is pending owner.

AC-OPS-07c.evidence: docker is not usable on the machine that built this phase (the user is not in the docker group and rootless docker is blocked by user-namespace restrictions), so the image could not be built or run; pending owner run on a machine with docker: the test builds the image, starts it with -it and checks it. The static Dockerfile checks run everywhere. The run also covers a uid with no passwd entry (--user 4321:4321 with a private config mount) and the container's peer filter (requests arrive from the container gateway, accepted; --allow-peer is for rootless Docker and Docker Desktop).
